name: UNDP A2F — ToT on Value Chain Quality Improvement and Export Readiness for MSMEs
summary: Four 20-day hands-on Training of Trainers (Edible Oils, Grapes & Raisins, Dried Fruits & Nuts, Dairy) for 100 participants across Mazar-e-Sharif, Herat, Kandahar and Kabul, with toolkits, post-ToT coaching, cascade monitoring and Quality-to-Finance referrals.

name: FAO EFSP-AF2 Matching Grants — Business Development Services (BDS)
client: FAO Afghanistan — Emergency Food Security Project (EFSP-AF2)
summary: Business Development Services for agribusinesses receiving FAO matching grants: digitised diagnostics, 3-year business plans, online capacity-building modules, field mentoring through the BDS Momentum Period, grant-utilisation support and market, farmer and finance linkages. Current plan covers Tranche 0 (5 enterprises) and Tranche 1 (6 enterprises); contract target 150 agribusinesses (≥30% women-owned/led) benefiting 15,000+ smallholders (≥20% women).
